summary.text: Doug Blex is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 12 (Montgomery County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2017.
Doug Blex is listed as a vice chair of the Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Doug Blex is listed as a member of the Local Government Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Health and Human Services Committee and the Water Committee.
The Legislature lists Doug Blex's occupation as Wildlife Biologist/Farmer.
The page names Meggin as Doug Blex's spouse.
